base_decision: Reuse Web 6Pro procedural art. Rebuild shared deterministic combat/server core. Preserve ground-stone affordance seen in candidate A; do not claim copying external repositories.
repo_reuse_finding: Only Three.js dependency is evidenced by inspected files. No verified git-clone/import evidence of an external finished game. No conclusion can be drawn about model training or unseen provenance.
prompt_finding: Clear classroom brief specified camera, device, characters, monster trigger, route, win/loss and scope. This plausibly reduced ambiguity. No controlled prompt ablation was run, so it does not prove the cause of GLM quality.
